description: Find local businesses that let AI assistants book through Belline. Matches words against the business name, trade, services and address as text; it does not search by distance. Returns each business with its services and price ranges, in its own currency. Only businesses whose owner switched this on are listed.

lang.description: Language code the business speaks, for example de or en. Optional.

q.description: Words to match, for example 'plumber Marina'. Optional.

trade.description: A trade key as it appears in a business result (tradeKey), for example trades. Optional; when absent, the words in q are matched on their own.

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
